item.title: X Shifts U.S. Creator Payouts From Stripe to X Money
item.description: X (formerly Twitter) moves all U.S. creator payouts to its in‑house X Money service, ending Stripe ties and offering instant, fee‑free payments.

item.title: SEC Probes AI Hedge Fund After Billion‑Dollar Collapse
item.description: A deep dive into the SEC’s subpoena of banks tied to Situational Awareness, the AI‑focused hedge fund that lost billions as AI stocks tumbled.

item.title: FGV Capital $35M Fund II, Merging Advisory & VC
item.description: Fiat Ventures rebrands its advisory and VC arms into FGV Capital, launching a $35M Fund II focused on AI‑driven fintech, healthcare, and commerce.

item.title: Stripe’s $53B PayPal Bid: Fintech’s Next Power Move
item.description: Stripe and Advent International eye a $53B PayPal buyout, reshaping fintech with Venmo, crypto, and $3.7T in annual payments.

item.title: Apple Pay Set to Launch in India This October Soon
item.description: Apple Pay will debut in India this October, supporting Visa and Mastercard while UPI integration awaits NPCI clearance and bank partnerships.

item.title: Ellis AI Raises $10M Seed to Modernize Private Credit Ops
item.description: Ellis AI, founded by Cadre creator Ryan Williams, lands a $10 M seed round to unify fragmented private‑credit workflows with AI agents and integration.

item.title: Paradigm Raises $1.2B
